description: This file contains React hooks and utility classes for managing asynchronous operations, state, and error handling within the Mattermost web application, specifically related to system properties in the admin console.

classes.name: BatchProcessingError
classes.description: Custom error class for batch processing errors, with optional cause details.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Determines loading and error states from a generic loading/error state.

methods.name: useOperationStatus
methods.description: Custom hook to track loading and error status of an async operation.

methods.name: useOperation
methods.description: Custom hook to perform an async operation with built-in status and error handling.

methods.name: useThing
methods.description: Hook to retrieve and manage a piece of state from Redux or an async source.

methods.name: usePendingThing
methods.description: Hook to manage a pending update to a data object, with commit and reset capabilities.
